name: templates-live-reload
body: Templates live reload: while `kalide start` runs, changes anywhere under the RESOLVED library root — the configured `templates:` path when set, otherwise the local `templates/` (see external-template-library) — are detected like deck changes; the resolved library is re-validated, templates/themes reloaded, the deck re-validated and re-rendered, and the browser reloads (or shows the full-page templates error).
